title: docs(qa): re-point the half-B platform-checklist items that described an older product
body:
Part of #24036
Clause-②: no

## Summary

Half B of #24036: revises the eight half-B area files of the platform checklist (dashboards, i18n, identity-auth, integration-system, platform-core, records-forms, studio-authoring, ux-conventions) against current `main`. Each item gets a `revision` bump and a `history` row naming #24036. Docs only: no product code, no published package touched. `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` is green.

Each revised item whose edit changed a fixture, a step's request or an oracle was re-run once, on an app built from this tree. 26 re-runs were filed as `qa-run` records before the PM ruling. Every later re-run is evidenced below instead, per the maintainer ruling relayed by the PM: 「或者这种测试只有有问题才立卡」 (file a card only when there is a problem). A re-run that showed a stale clause was fixed in this diff. Nothing is loosened past its ruling: clauses score codes, statuses and data, never wording.

## Evidence for the re-runs without a record

Format: item · clauses driven · verdict · the oracle line.

- **`records-forms.crud-roundtrip`** · A0–A7, N0, N3 · **pass** · UI create POST 201 re-read verbatim (website null); PATCH {"annual_revenue":1234567} → diff = that key + updated_at; History shows display values; 华宁 round-trip + search; clone 201 new id, owner = cloner (source owned by another user); contributor-bound member clone of INV-1003 → 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND, count 13→13; header-menu Delete → DELETE 200, filtered GET 0; pins 11+21 green
- **`records-forms.list-view-capabilities`** · A0–A9 (11 variants) · **pass** · In Progress: GET showcase_task?…filter=[["status","equals","in_progress"]] 200, "2 records" = API total 2; Accounts search → `search=huaning` → 华宁科技; Task List → `sort=-estimate_hours`, server order descending, 0 page errors; 55 inquiries via createMany (bare array) → Inquiries list requests top=50 then top=50&skip=50, union 59 = total, no unpaged fetch; Grid inline edit → Save All (1) → PATCH {"estimate_hours":31}, diff = that key + audit; export grant qa_task_export bound (before: 403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED) → Display footer "Export as CSV / XLSX / JSON", each request carries the in_progress filter, CSV / JSON / XLSX each hold the 2 rows; Display → Layout offers exactly Grid / Kanban / Gallery / Calendar / Timeline / Gantt, each re-renders the tasks; Mark Done on 3 rows → 3 POST /actions/showcase_task/showcase_mark_done, Recalculate Selection → 1 POST /api/v1/apps/showcase/recalc {"_selectedIds":[3 ids]}; legacy row menu Reopen / Reassign… / Quick View (once) / Recalculate Estimate, Recalc → POST /apps/showcase/recalc {recordId}; Field Zoo: Specimen — Full row carries rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.08), Minimal does not
- **`records-forms.conditional-rules-grid`** · A0–A4 · **pass** · INV-1002 Edit form grid (second line seeded at position 1): line 1 qty 120 + empty description → only that cell flagged (data-testid line-items-invalid-0-description, "Description is required"), line 2 (qty 1) unflagged; Update → the one batch POST /api/v1/batch answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED {description, required}, rows unchanged (scored per the revised verify); filled → batch 200, only line 1 changed, sibling updated_at unchanged; direct POST line qty 120 no description → 400 description/required, count 2→2; Status Paid in the form → product / qty / unit price disabled, Draft → enabled, no reload; receipt upload → batch 200, line receipt {id, name, size, url /api/v1/storage/files/ID}; GET of that url answers 302 to the stored object and the sys_file row reads qa-receipt.txt, 29 bytes
